response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and distributed systems, but the role's core requirement — hands-on C++/STL development for high-performance industrial platforms — is essentially absent from recent experience. C++ appears only in a ~6-month stint at National Instruments (2014) and an academic thesis; the last decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js, D, and web/cloud product work. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL security practice, MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), message-broker architectures in C++, or Azure. Low-latency D-lang microservices at Sociomantic and event-driven platform work show relevant systems thinking, but the technical and domain gap to industrial automation is too large for a mid-senior specialist hire.
strengths: Deep low-latency, concurrent, event-driven systems experience (D, async I/O, fibers)
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring and workshops
15+ years across embedded, backend, and full-stack; proven ownership as founder/staff engineer
concerns: Minimal and dated C++/STL experience (~6 months, 2014)
No IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity background
No IoT/industrial protocol (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA) or Azure exposure

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation / security standards domain gap
